note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Steps of browser/app screens are done by hand by the person recording.
prepare: if (-not (Get-ChildItem C:\MGLab\tools\deneb\*.pbiviz -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $assets = (Invoke-RestMethod https://api.github.com/repos/deneb-viz/deneb/releases/tags/2.0.0.0).assets | Where-Object name -like '*.pbiviz'; $a = @($assets | Where-Object name -like '*standalone*') + @($assets) | Select-Object -First 1; Invoke-WebRequest $a.browser_download_url -OutFile (Join-Path C:\MGLab\tools\deneb $a.name) }

screens.name: viz-report-overview
steps: Open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep04\src\ContosoSales.pbip and Refresh; Design > Import theme > src\themes\ContosoBikes.json if the blue first series (#0B5CAD) is missing
Page Sales overview, Year slicer = 2025
Check cards: Sales amount 967,472.88, Sales growth vs prior year 8.1%, Orders 1,268; line chart, bar chart (Bikes > Accessories > Clothing), products table, empty cell bottom right
Optional second take: View > Selection > Tab order visible (3 cards, slicer, line, bar, table)
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: viz-target-bullet
steps: File > Options and settings > Options > Current file > Report settings: Develop a visual on (this session)
Visualizations pane ... > Import a visual from a file > C:\MGLab\power-bi\*.pbiviz > Import
Add Target Bullet in the free cell (x 648, y 432, 608 x 264); Category = Product[Category], Actual = Sales Amount, Target = Sales PY; title Sales vs prior year by category
Year = 2025: Accessories up +8.4%, Bikes up +9.0%, Clothing circle -3.0%
Format pane > Bands: On-target tolerance (%) = 5, then set 2: Clothing turns down marker -3.0%
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

screens.name: viz-deneb
steps: Same session as viz-target-bullet (ContosoSales.pbip open, refreshed, theme applied)
Off camera: open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep04\src\deneb\target-bullet.vl.json in Notepad, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+C

Visualizations pane ... > Import a visual from a file > type C:\MGLab\tools\deneb\<the .pbiviz prepare printed> > Open > Import > OK (no sign-in; do NOT use Get more visuals / AppSource, that needs an account)
Add a page 'Deneb'; copy the Year slicer from Sales overview (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V; answer Sync if asked) and set 2025
Insert the Deneb visual, about 900 x 360; Values: Product[Category], then Sales Amount, then Sales PY (display names must stay exactly Category, Sales Amount, Sales PY)
Visual header ... > Edit > Create new specification: [empty] template, Vega-Lite > Create (labels may differ slightly in 2.0; any empty Vega-Lite start works, the paste replaces it)
Specification tab: select all, paste (Ctrl+V), Ctrl+Enter (Apply): three rows, Bikes +9.0% and Accessories +8.4% with up triangles, Clothing circle -3.0%, a dark tick at the prior year; hold
Back to report; hold on the page. Optional: hover a bar for the tooltip
Off camera, after stopping the recording: right-click the 'Deneb' page tab > Delete page > Delete; keep Desktop open for viz-showcase (never save into the repo copy)
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in the import file dialog (type the C:\MGLab path in the File name box, do not browse the nav pane)

screens.name: viz-showcase
steps: Off camera, only if Desktop was closed after viz-deneb: open C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep04\src\ContosoSales.pbip, Home > Refresh; File > Options and settings > Options > Current file > Report settings > Develop a visual: on > OK; Visualizations pane ... > Import a visual from a file > click the File name box, type C:\MGLab\power-bi\contosoTargetBullet7C1E2A9B4D5F4E0A8B3C6D2E1F0A9B8C.1.0.0.0.pbiviz > Open > Import > OK

Off camera: the report must show the Contoso Bikes theme (light canvas, blue first series). If not: Design > Import theme > click the File name box > type C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep04\src\themes\ContosoBikes.json > Enter > close the confirmation

Off camera check: click the page tab 'Showcase'. The Year slicer must show tiles (2024, 2025, 2026) and Target Bullet must draw three rows. If the slicer is a vertical list: select it > Format visual > Visual > Slicer settings > Options > Style > Tile. Click the page tab 'Sales overview' to go back
Start recording (on Sales overview)
Click the page tab 'Showcase' at the bottom of the canvas. Hold 2 s

Click the '2025' tile in the Year slicer (top right). Check: cards Sales amount 967.47K (or 967,472.88), Growth 8.1%, Orders 1,268 (or 1.27K), Units sold 3,811 (or 3.81K); Target Bullet: Accessories up +8.4%, Bikes up +9.0%, Clothing circle -3.0%; Top products starts with Enduro 300. Hold 4 s
Click the 'Design' tab in the ribbon (older Desktop builds: the 'View' tab)
Click 'Import theme' (older builds: the Themes gallery drop-down arrow > 'Browse for themes')

In the Open dialog click the 'File name' box (do NOT click anything in the navigation pane: it shows the Windows user folder), type C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep04\src\themes\ContosoNightRide.json and press Enter
Desktop shows a dialog that the theme was imported: click its button to close it

Hold 6 s on the dark page: near-black canvas, LED-blue card numbers, blue and orange lines, dark banded table. Optional: hover one point of the line chart for the tooltip, then move the mouse off the canvas
Stop recording

Off camera, before viz-high-contrast: Design > Import theme > click the File name box > type C:\MGLab\power-bi\ep04\src\themes\ContosoBikes.json > Enter > close the confirmation; click the page tab 'Sales overview' (hcscreen shows that page). At the end of the session close Desktop without saving (Don't save)
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)

Windows user name in the Open dialog (type the C:\MGLab path in the File name box, do not browse the nav pane); if the nav pane shows a personal folder or OneDrive name, cut the dialog with video_cuts as in importscreen

screens.name: viz-high-contrast
steps: Settings > Accessibility > Contrast themes > Night sky > Apply (Desktop picks it up automatically)
Show the page: Target Bullet bars outlined in the foreground colour, markers and percentages visible, core visuals also in high contrast
Switch the contrast theme back to None
mask: account name and picture at the top right of Power BI Desktop (sign out first)
Windows user name in any file path (record from C:\MGLab)

teardown: # Deneb .pbiviz stays in C:\MGLab\tools\deneb; to remove: Remove-Item C:\MGLab\tools\deneb -Recurse -Force
owner_notes: Local only. Windows contrast theme must be set back to None after hcscreen. Node 24 builds the visual (needs 20.19+). viz-deneb: Deneb 2.0.0 (free, MIT) standalone .pbiviz downloaded by prepare into C:\MGLab\tools\deneb from the GitHub release (no admin, no AppSource sign-in). Record it before viz-high-contrast so the contrast theme is off. viz-showcase: record right after viz-deneb (Target Bullet still imported) and before viz-high-contrast; it imports src/themes/ContosoNightRide.json, so switch back to ContosoBikes.json afterwards (last step). Theme import is Design > Import theme on current Desktop (Learn, Use report themes, updated 2026-09-29); View > Themes > Browse for themes only on older builds. Typing paths in the File name box keeps the Windows user folder off screen.
